title: claudegrid config
description: Project (.claudegrid.json) or user (~/.config/claudegrid/config.json) config for claudegrid.

layout.description: Grid as COLSxROWS ("3x2") or a pane count ("6"). Wins over a numeric `panes`.

panes.description: How many panes to open, or one entry per pane in reading order (left to right, top to bottom).

backend.description: Terminal that hosts the grid. `auto` prefers the terminal you are in.

worktrees.description: Give every pane its own git worktree and `claudegrid/...` branch, next to the repo in `<repo>.claudegrid/`.

args.description: Extra Claude Code flags for every pane. Args from each config layer add up.

keepShell.description: Drop into your shell when the program exits instead of closing the pane.

dir.description: Base directory for every pane, relative to this file.

newTab.description: Open the grid as a new tab in the terminal you run claudegrid from (Konsole, WezTerm, tmux). false opens a new window.

trust.description: Mark every pane folder as trusted in Claude Code, so it does not ask the trust question in each pane. false lets it ask.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for a pane with only a prompt.

name.description: Pane title, and the worktree branch name when worktrees are on. Must be unique.

dir.description: Directory for this pane, relative to the config file.

prompt.description: First message sent to Claude in this pane.

model.description: Overrides the grid model for this pane.

args.description: Extra Claude Code flags for this pane only.
